title: HustleBox v1.3.5 — Cutscene Redo, Compact Work, Side Hustle Layout, Touch Feedback
message:
Bug fixes and visual polish based on your feedback.

CUTSCENE REDESIGNED FOR HEAD-DOWN POV
Your original spec: 'You look downward on the floor. You can see part of their legs, maybe their arms. You'd see the bottom half of the door, maybe a slight color and circular object of the doorknob.' I'd been rendering the full door, which was wrong.

Now:
• Floor takes 75% of the frame (was 60%) — head is bent down, floor dominates
• Door is drawn very tall but most of it is above the viewport (top is clipped) — only the bottom portion is in view
• Doorknob anchored to the door's visible bottom edge, positioned upper-middle of view
• Door barely moves — just a subtle scale (0.9 to 1.08) to suggest approach. NO MORE dramatic descent.
• Feet pushed closer to bottom of screen
• Vignette darker at top, focuses your eye downward

SIDE HUSTLE LAYOUT — SINGLE COLUMN
You said you didn't want the two-column indent — just smaller emoji and text. Reverted to single-column rows. Each row is full-width with the emoji inline before the name, and the timing/payout aligned to the right side.

COMPACT WORK PAGE
Parked-truck view is now: Day & 5th and Main, the 'RAY'S' card with OPEN button, and Ray's quote. That's it. Removed the menu board, the customer-flow/tip/rep card, and the redundant 'Open the Window' button at the bottom. The OPEN button on the card starts your shift.

IOS/ANDROID-STYLE TOUCH FEEDBACK
When you press a button, row, or toggle, you now get tactile feedback:
• Buttons scale to 96%, brighten 18%, get an amber ring
• Primary buttons get a brighter amber glow
• Ghost buttons (the secondary style) get a subtle amber wash
• Rows (Settings, Account, etc.) get a warm amber background + border highlight + slight scale-down, like the Bluetooth setting on your phone
• Toggles inside rows get an amber ring when their parent row is pressed
• iOS default grey tap-highlight is killed so our feedback shows clearly

DEFERRED TO v1.3.6 (next update):
• First-load save chooser (local vs server) + setting to switch later
• Tutorial popups for Settings and More
• Update Log / Achievements / Profile pagination so they don't scroll

Those are larger UX refactors that need their own pass. Telling you up front instead of half-shipping them.

No save data wiped.
